context: Techfest, IIT Bombay (Asia's Largest Science & Technology Festival)
disclaimer: Independent Creative Concept for Techfest, IIT Bombay

chapters.title: THE SPARK
chapters.headline: THE FUTURE DOESN'T WAIT. IT BEGINS WITH YOU.
chapters.subtext: Every extraordinary invention begins with an extraordinary question.

chapters.title: THE IMAGINATION
chapters.headline: BEFORE THE INVENTION, THERE WAS AN IDEA.
chapters.subtext: Curiosity transforms possibilities into plans. Imagination gives technology its first shape.

chapters.title: THE CREATION
chapters.headline: IDEAS ARE NOTHING WITHOUT THE COURAGE TO BUILD.
chapters.subtext: From the first prototype to complex machines, engineering turns imagination into reality.

chapters.title: THE FRONTIER
chapters.headline: THERE ARE NO FINISH LINES TO HUMAN CURIOSITY.
chapters.subtext: From artificial intelligence to robotics, aerospace and emerging sciences, the next frontier is waiting to be explored.

chapters.title: THE GATHERING
chapters.headline: WHERE THE WORLD COMES TO BUILD TOMORROW.
chapters.subtext: Ideas become more powerful when minds meet. Experience the energy of competitions, demonstrations, exhibitions and learning.

chapters.title: THE INVITATION
chapters.headline: THE NEXT REVOLUTION NEEDS YOU.
chapters.subtext: Don't just witness the future. Become part of the people creating it.

domains.name: Artificial Intelligence
domains.description: Neural architectures, autonomous reasoning, generative systems, and cognitive computing pushing the boundaries of machine intelligence.

domains.name: Robotics
domains.description: Humanoid kinematics, swarm autonomy, bio-inspired locomotion, and industrial mechatronics engineered for extreme environments.

domains.name: Aerospace
domains.description: Orbital propulsion, autonomous flight dynamics, satellite constellations, and deep-space exploration vehicles.

domains.name: Quantum Technology
domains.description: Quantum cryptography, superconducting qubits, entanglement networks, and next-generation computational paradigms.

domains.name: Innovation & Engineering
domains.description: Sustainable energy grids, metamaterials, biotech interfaces, and breakthrough civil & mechanical systems.

experiences.title: Competitions
experiences.description: High-stakes national and international challenges across robotics, coding, aerospace, and design where innovators compete to solve real-world problems.

experiences.title: Exhibitions
experiences.description: Global showcases of cutting-edge humanoid robots, defense technology, autonomous vehicles, and research demonstrations from pioneering labs.

experiences.title: Workshops
experiences.description: Hands-on technical intensives led by industry practitioners covering AI, quantum computing, embedded systems, cybersecurity, and financial engineering.

experiences.title: Lectures & Experiences
experiences.description: Keynote addresses from global laureates, scientific visionaries, and tech leaders alongside electrifying night-time technoholix performances and summits.
